title: Finite products preserve coprimality
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, let $I$ be a type, let $x\in R$, let $s:I\to R$, and let $t$ be a finite subset of $I$. If

$$
\forall i\in t,\;\operatorname{IsCoprime}(s(i),x),
$$

then

$$
\operatorname{IsCoprime}\left(\prod_{i\in t}s(i),x\right).
$$

Here $\operatorname{IsCoprime}$ is the generic Mathlib coprimality predicate; when $R$ is a polynomial ring over a field, it is the polynomial coprimality notion of [def-weil-coprime-polynomials].

source.place: proof, first paragraph: "consequently the parity products $N_\ell,D_\ell$ ... are coprime"
